description: Angular component for editing and collaborating on documents, including websocket-based real-time updates and UI interactions.

classes.name: DocumentEditorComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing documents with real-time collaboration support.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component state and sets up collaboration subscription if applicable.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscription and disconnects collaboration websocket.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Emits the save event with updated document details and sends collaboration edit.

methods.name: onCollabMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming collaboration messages, updating the content or title accordingly.

methods.name: onContentChange
methods.description: Sends live updates over websocket as user types, if applicable.

methods.name: onTitleChange
methods.description: Triggers content change handler when title is modified.
